_doc: Long Straddle v2b — single-condition VRP<0 gate. May 6 2026. Built post LC v2/v2b verdict (commit e09eb9b) where long calendar with any regime gate failed because the structure requires spot to stay near strike — Indian post-SEBI's intraday vol violates that on a majority of days. Long straddle inverts the structural assumption: directional movement is the source of profit, not catastrophe. Same VRP<0 gate as LC v2b, different vehicle. If LS v2b succeeds where LC v2b failed, the binding constraint was the calendar STRUCTURE; if LS v2b also fails, long-vol on Indian post-SEBI options is structurally untradable and the next move is a pivot to NIFTY futures.
